title: Build a revision evidence registry
responsibility: Read unit and scenario manifests and budget history at the pinned revision.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceRegistry.context
inputs.description: A revision-pinned HubSourceContext supplies the source adapter, repository, commit, tree entries, cache identity and cache used to read committed blobs. This function reads unit manifests, matching scenario-manifest paths, and the budget ledger only when that ledger is present; adapter and cache failures propagate.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceRegistry
outputs.description: The resolved value is a revision registry of sorted unit and scenario views plus dependency and coverage graph; available is false and gap is added when no unit manifests exist. Every matching scenario path is schema-checked and must match its declared id, and a present ledger must contain valid UTF-8 NDJSON budget events or the call rejects.

examples.gap: no unit registry is stored at this revision

errors.name: Hub committed evidence registry missing or corrupt
errors.description: hubFail raises an Error when a source blob is missing, an artifact is invalid, a manifest path does not match its id, duplicate unit ids occur, or a ledger event fails validation; invalid JSON or UTF-8 in a manifest is surfaced as an artifact-corrupt Error.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: JSON.parse rejects a non-empty budget-ledger line that is not valid JSON.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Fatal UTF-8 decoding rejects a present budget ledger whose bytes are not valid UTF-8.
